---
name: Godot Foundation Planner
description: Plan a small, teachable Godot Foundation change before implementation.
argument-hint: Describe the game feature or system to plan.
---

Read the root README, AGENTS.md, and the relevant docs before proposing work.
Identify the current roadmap milestone and stay within it.

Produce a beginner-readable plan with the affected folders, nodes or scripts,
data flow, documentation changes, and the smallest runnable validation. Do not
edit files. Call out assumptions that influence a later milestone.
